name: Dreams
overview: Scripture reveals that God communicates important truths and warnings through dreams, as seen when He warned Abimelech in a dream to prevent sin and death (Genesis 20:3-7). Dreams can serve as divine messages, exemplified by Joseph's prophetic dreams which stirred strong reactions among his brothers (Genesis 37:5). These passages emphasize that God sovereignly uses dreams to guide, protect, and reveal His will to His people.
